hypotheses: Primary cause: a temporary fixture-mode delay of approximately 2.5 seconds was enabled inside the LLM generate() operation, which is the operation covered by the latency histogram.
Supporting telemetry: the API LLM latency bucket for le=5.0 had value 17 at 2026-09-25T04:13:30.786Z, while the recorded p95 was above its one-hour upper band during the alert window.
Impact: chat generation requests were substantially slower while the explicit test delay was active; retrieval and document ingestion were not part of the injected fault.

Recovery: the temporary delay was disabled and normal chat traffic was allowed to continue until the alert became inactive. The exact alert-series transition was observed before the final recovery observation, so the report retains that limitation.
observed_symptom: The LLM latency p95 exceeded its one-hour statistical upper band and InsightHubLLMLatencyAnomaly fired.
primary_cause: Temporary explicit fixture-mode delay inside generate().
impact: Elevated latency for API chat generation requests during the controlled incident.
recovery_action: Removed the temporary delay and continued normal requests until latency and alert state recovered.
evidence_limitations: The Prometheus firing series stopped emitting before the final delay-disable observation; no conclusion is made about an exact resolve transition beyond the recorded inactive checks.
